user_prompt: I need to pull together our incident tracking data for the quarterly board review while simultaneously updating several customer cases that are stuck in our resolution queue—can you help me access both of those systems in one go so I don't have to toggle between platforms?

steps.step_name: Pull together incident tracking data for the quarterly board review

args.content:
LANDSCAPE SYSTEMS (11 total):
- workday.hcm: HCM with compensation agents but NO API resources
- sap.sf: SuccessFactors HCM - INCLUDES:
  * apiResource:EmployeeCompensationManagement:v1 - Extract payroll/compensation records
  * agent:CompensationPolicyAutomationEngine:v1 - Compensation policy automation
  * agent:SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator:v1 - Workforce planning
- sap.s4: ERP - agents (procurement, order automation, engineering change), MaterialReceiptInboundAPI (goods receipt inbound only)
- sap.crm: CRM with opportunity qualification AGENTS ONLY - NO API resources for customer account/purchase data
- sap.ehs: Safety/health - AGENTS:
  * IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1 - Analyzes SafetyIncidents, identifies root causes, generates reports with corrective actions
  * IncidentResponseCoordinator:v1 - Routes incidents, escalates emergencies
  * SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator:v1 - BOM validation, supplier qualification
  * VendorComplianceAutomationOrchestrator:v1 - Vendor safety certification verification
  * VendorComplianceInvoiceAutomation:v1 - Invoice validation
  * ComplianceCampaignOrchestrator:v1 - Campaign-level compliance automation
- sap.ariba: Procurement - APIs (PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI, SourceingCampaignAndAccountManagementAPI, ProcurementWorkforceCompensationAPI), agent validating hazardous materials
- corp.itsm: IT service management AGENTS (ENTERPRISE INCIDENT TRACKING):
  * IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1 - Analyzes ServiceTickets, correlates incident patterns, generates diagnostic reports with preventive actions (BEST for board-level incident tracking)
  * IncidentSafetyCoordinator:v1, OccupationalSafetyIncidentCoordinator:v1 - Safety-focused incident workflows
  * AssetProvisioningOrchestrator:v1, ChangeAutomationOrchestrator:v1 - Change/asset management
- emarsys.cx: Customer experience/marketing engagement AGENTS ONLY - NO API resources
- my.mes: Manufacturing - ProductionQualityMonitor, ProductionChangeOrchestrator, SupplierQualityComplianceOrchestrator (vendor/procurement compliance), BillOfMaterialsComplianceValidator AGENTS ONLY
- siemens.plm: PLM - BOMComplianceValidator, EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning, QualityAssuranceAndDefectPrevention, SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator AGENTS ONLY
- sap.odm: Entity type repository (not API provider)

GOODS RECEIPT vs INVOICING:
- MaterialReceiptInboundAPI (sap.s4) handles goods receipt/shipment arrival BEFORE invoice
- Goods receipt is separate warehouse/inventory process
- Invoicing is separate downstream process

INCIDENT TRACKING FOR BOARD REVIEW:
- corp.itsm:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1 - BEST for enterprise-wide incident tracking
  * Processes ServiceTickets with root cause analysis
  * Generates diagnostic reports suitable for quarterly board review
  * Correlates incident patterns and historical data for trend analysis
- sap.ehs:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1 - For SAFETY incidents specifically

args.reason: Autonomously analyzes and correlates incident patterns from service tickets to generate diagnostic reports with root cause findings and preventive measures, enabling board-level visibility into enterprise incident trends for quarterly review.
